post.summary: Register a new account (sends an email confirmation link)

get.summary: Confirm an email address using the token from the confirmation link

post.summary: Send the email confirmation link again (only to an account that isn't confirmed yet)

get.summary: Current principal: id, email, roles, permissions

post.summary: Revoke every refresh token and sign-in session of the current user
Get the authenticator shared key + otpauth URI (needs the password; 409 once 2FA is enabled)
Enable 2FA with the password and a TOTP code; returns new recovery codes, also when 2FA is already on (ends every session when it turns 2FA on)
Disable 2FA with the password and a TOTP code (ends every session)

get.summary: Get the antiforgery token the sign-in requests send back in a header

post.summary: Sign in with email and password; opens the provider's session, returns no token
Finish signing in with an authenticator or recovery code
Email a code to reset the password (only to a confirmed account; the same answer for every address)
Set a new password with the emailed code (ends every session, signs nobody in)

get.summary: List all permissions declared by modules

post.summary: Grant a role to a user (a role with identity:* permissions, Administrator included, also needs identity:roles:manage; ends the user's sessions)

delete.summary: Revoke a role from a user (a role with identity:* permissions, Administrator included, also needs identity:roles:manage; the last administrator keeps it)

post.summary: Read an invitation: the invited address, or why it can't be accepted
Accept an invitation: set the password and confirm the address (signs nobody in)
Invite a person to an account (creates it when the address has none; changes no existing account)
Create a payment for a product

get.summary: List your payments, or everyone's with payments:read-all (paged)
